item.title: Top Pick: Potbelly: Week of Perks: BOGO 50% Off Entrees and a New Deal Every Day Through October 2
item.guid: Potbelly-Week of Perks: BOGO 50% Off Entrees and -2026-10-01
item.description: Potbelly's fifth annual Week of Perks runs September 28 to October 2: a different deal each day for Potbelly Perks members (free account required), announced in the app each morning, including buy-one-get-one 50% off entrees. Order in the app, on potbelly.com, or scan your Perks account in shop. (Select states only) (Through October 2, 2026)
